# Figures and tables

Use actual target/campaign labels, stable design IDs, named axes and units. Show
missing observations explicitly. Record source tables/hashes, grouping, selection
rules, sample counts and tool versions. Distinguish confidence scales and methods.
Comparable panels use consistent axes and color meanings. Retain plotting code
and data provenance; inspect exports for clipping and legibility. Export vector
figures where useful and sufficient-resolution raster molecular images.
